steps: Run c-round-27/setup.sh at 1440x900 and apply the lay11 layout (video 0-6.008, music 0-16, stems 2-18, SFX 4-6)
Run c-round-25/scripts/vm-start.js, real-click Master Mute at ~0.5 s and again at ~2.3 s, then press ArrowDown 12 times on Master Volume at ~3.2 s
Run c-round-25/scripts/vm-an.js and read video.driftMaxAbs and the dock counters
bugs.expected: The video drift max is <= 30.1 ms (round 26's 20.1 ms + 10 ms) and the dock counters go from 0 to 0 (R27-RB cost oracle)
bugs.actual: 4 of 5 runs exceed 30.1 ms: 81.7, 36.2, 46.1, 20.6 and 41.6 ms. Every run has dock hardSeeks 2/2 (round 26: 0/0). Two control runs with the track analyser reads replaced by zeros give 60.4 and 130.6 ms, so the track reads are probably not the cause. Round 26 sampled a music-muted layout, so attribution is open.

steps: Run npx vitest run with the 8 frozen files (render-budget, track-layout, master-ui, meter, master, graph, ArrangementContext, export-dialog-focus) as one batch, 3 times
